name: Mixed Scales
prerequisites:
Draconic Aspect or dragon-scaled racial
 trait, kobold
benefit:
Choose an additional color for your Draconic
 Aspect feat or dragon-scaled racial trait. You gain the
 benefits of both this color and the color you originally
 chose. (If you have both Draconic Aspect and dragon-scaled,
 this benefit applies to both.) If you gain abilities that rely on
 scale color, choose which color gains the benefits.
flavor: You have two colors of scales, which mark you as special.
